snippet.description:
Quantum computers need to be colder than outer space to work, and getting there means hunting down one of the rarest, most expensive substances on Earth. So where do you even find it? 

This week on Unexplainable: We talk to a reporter who took a trip to the coldest place on Earth to find out what it takes to build the future of quantum computing. Watch on Netflix or listen wherever you get your podcasts.

Subscribe to our channel and turn on notifications (🔔) so you don't miss any videos: http://goo.gl/0bsAjO
